items.title: Mustafizur retained by IPL-owned Dubai Capitals for ILT20
items.summary: Mustafizur Rahman has been retained by Dubai Capitals for the upcoming edition of the UAE’s ILT20, giving the Bangladesh pacer another opportunity to play for a franchise owned by an Indian Premier League team.

items.title: ‘I don’t want Bangladesh to need Tony Hemming forever’
items.summary: Hemming spoke to The Daily Star's Abdullah Al Mehdi after Tuesday's opening session in Chattogram about mastering local conditions and ending the reliance on foreign expertise.

items.title: India-Bangladesh series faces fresh scheduling clash
items.summary: With less than three weeks remaining before the proposed dates, the Bangladesh tour appears increasingly unlikely

items.title: 'Rana is a big out': Australia all-rounder Webster
items.summary: Australia all-rounder Beau Webster believes Nahid Rana’s absence is a big blow for Bangladesh heading into the Tests in Darwin and Mackay, but says Australia also face an element of the unknown with Bangladesh’s bowling attack.

items.title: Shoriful could follow in Hasan’s footsteps to county cricket
items.summary: Bangladesh left-arm pacer Shoriful Islam could follow in Hasan Mahmud’s footsteps and turn out for Kent, with the county club having expressed interest in signing him, sources confirmed on Tuesday.

items.title: Bangladesh and India scramble to save white-ball series
items.summary: Bangladesh is scrambling to save a six-match cricket tour by neighbour India next month with the foreign ministers of both nations roped in to try to salvage the series.

items.title: Webster with a point to prove against Bangladesh
items.summary: Webster only made his Test debut at the start of last year and the 32-year-old has already experienced plenty of highs and lows through eight Test match appearances as he attempts to cement his place in the best XI for the World Test Championship pacesetters.

items.title: Taskin ready to shoulder pace burden in Australia
items.summary: With Nahid Rana ruled out of the series and Shoriful Islam unavailable for the first Test, the burden on Taskin will be far greater.

items.title: Taskin 'honoured' to play Test series in Australia, 14 years after first visit
